messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "may have relapse of depression if stop taking antidepressant"
set: ["may have relapse of depression if stop taking antidepressant", "some young people may have thoughts about suicide when first taking antidepressant", "risk of depression if discontinued during pregnancy", "people with depression or mental illness may have thoughts about suicide", "may not be able to use if have glaucoma", "depression comes back if discontinued during pregnancy", "some young people may have increased suicidal thoughts when first starting a medicine to treat depression", "breathing problems or withdrawal symptoms if you start or stop taking certain other medicines", "taking certain oral diabetes medicines may increase risk of serious heart problems", "may increase risk of eclampsia", "problems may occur when you first start taking tramadol", "more likely in people with depression", "new or worse depression or anxiety", "may increase risk of muscle problems", "may increase risk of unintended pregnancy", "taking during late pregnancy may cause serious medical complications in baby"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
